## Problem

Programmable cloud laboratories enable remote, automated experimentation, but developing and evaluating orchestration methods on real hardware is slow and costly. Accurate simulation is needed to study these systems before deployment.

## Approach

I am building **CloudBench**, an open-framework simulator and benchmark generator for programmable cloud laboratories.

## Status

Manuscript in preparation (*CloudBench: An Open-Framework Simulator and Benchmark Generator for Programmable Cloud Laboratories*). Code and benchmarks will be released with the paper.
